limitations: Two raws fully unresolved; other ambiguous later/precolonial labels retain reviewed gaps.
All new dossiers are partial political cores, needs-research/none; no exhaustive enrichment.
BritishMuseum source bodies403 unavailable and not used as accepted evidence; UNESCO PDF unavailable; accessible independent institutional bodies used.
Production/Git unchanged by worker; browser rendering, root historical review and full tests belong to coordinator.
historicalCautions: All endpoints are exclusive editorial partial bounds unless a documented event date is explicit; dossiers are not full lifetimes.
Colonial legal structures do not prove consent, complete conquest, or uniform jurisdiction.
Benin Kingdom/Edo and later namedRepublicBenin are distinct; unresolved1945/1960 labels fail closed.
Gold Coast and Ghana linked by historical sources; colonial administrations preserved before1957 and monarchy/republic split at1July1960.
UpperVolta suppressed1932–47;1945 modernBurkinaFaso cannot receive a uniform administration.
Sokoto company treaties had competing interpretations; no company-claimed sovereignty inferred.
Asante component autonomy,1874 contraction,1896 resident rule and resistance qualified; no community dossier.
Kong political empire proven but government unknown; catalogue1710–1895 is not exact lifetime.
FutaToro/Tukulor source access only partial; unsafe late political mappings unresolved.
AOF membership/councils changed; colonial federation is a composite, not one indigenous political entity.
OriginalSenegal1960 constitution distinguished from appended1961/1962 and1963 regimes.
Independence-message named Prime Minister facts for Upper Volta/Ivory Coast retained only on the attested day; adjacent office chronology uncurated.
